core_struggle: After failing a bank exam four times, the whole village knows and his father has withdrawn from the chaupal; he cannot stop replaying it.
mirror: You keep going over the same failure, and the village is talking about it.

queries.hook: The weight of a failure everyone knows, and the shame that has reached your father, replayed in your mind until you cannot sleep. My project or startup failed.
queries.diagnose: When a result goes wrong, the mind turns against itself; self-blame grows from believing the outcome alone measures our worth, and it grows in the silence of the chaupal.
queries.steady: A failure is something that happened, not who you are; no one who tries to do good is ever lost, and your father's love is not measured by the exam.
queries.act: Lift yourself up instead of pushing yourself down; learn what this taught you, make amends where you can, and begin again.
queries.story: A man who failed again and again, faced the village's silence and his own shame, yet found the courage to rise again.

bridge: The village is talking about you, but the one who cannot stop going over it is your own mind, and the Gita says that is the real enemy.
insight: You replayed the failure last night. Underneath is the belief that the whole village's verdict is the truth of you.
details: failed a bank exam four times
father has stopped going to the chaupal
